grammar.title: Therefore with 因此
grammar.explanation: 因此 (yīncǐ) means "therefore, as a result" — a more formal, written alternative to 所以. It links a reason already stated to a resulting conclusion, and is common in essays, news, and explanations.

grammar.title: Formal cause with 由于
grammar.pattern: 由于 + 原因，(主语) + 结果
grammar.explanation: 由于 (yóuyú) is a formal way to say "because of, due to" — common in written Chinese and news. Like 因为, it can start the sentence, but it can also come directly before a short noun phrase rather than a full clause.

sentences.zh: 天气不好，因此比赛取消了。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì bù hǎo, yīncǐ bǐsài qǔxiāo le.
sentences.en: The weather was bad, so the match was cancelled.

sentences.zh: 由于天气不好，比赛取消了。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì bù hǎo, bǐsài qǔxiāo le.
sentences.en: Due to bad weather, the match was cancelled.

sentences.zh: 因为下雨，我们不得不取消比赛。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒmen bùdébù qǔxiāo bǐsài.
sentences.en: Because it rained, we had no choice but to cancel the match.
I usually get up at seven.
On weekends we usually go to the park.
